about_the_game:
The once-deep and tranquil forest is no longer peaceful.
At its forgotten center lies the Aether Altar, a once-sacred place that breathed life into the world—now weakened by greed and war, allowing darkness to spread across the woods.

You are the last descendant of the ancient forest.
Armed with only a small axe, your journey to reclaim the light begins.

🛠 Game Features

🔨 Self-sufficient Survival & Crafting
Swing your axe to chop trees, mine ore, and craft essential tools and defensive structures. Gather food and build fortifications to protect the altar.

⚔️ Nightly Monster Assaults
When night falls, corrupted creatures emerge from the shadows.
Set traps and upgrade your weapons to defend the altar from their onslaught.

🌲 Exploration & Purification
Explore new areas, discover rare resources, and cleanse corrupted dungeons and monster camps. Brightened regions remain on your map, leading to even greater challenges and rewards.

✨ Upgrade the Aether Altar
Restore the Aether Altar—the heart of your journey.
Once fully upgraded, the forest breathes again and your legend is born.

Forestia is a single-player 2D action fantasy game blending survival, combat, crafting, and exploration.
Drive out the darkness and return life to the forest—with your own hands.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2 Ghz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 256 mb video memory, shader model 3.0+
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Armed with only a small axe, explore a forest consumed by darkness. Gather resources, craft tools, and defend the sacred altar from nightly monster assaults. Restore the altar and bring life back to the land in this 2D survival action fantasy game.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
